1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 d5 4.Bg2 dxc4 5.Qa.strategy: Regains the pawn at once, so the g2 bishop gets its open long diagonal at no material cost. The price is a queen that has already moved twice and stands where Black's queenside pawns and knights can chase it, while Black has a free hand to organise.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 d5 4.Bg2 dxc4 5.Qa.name: Catalan Opening: Open Defence

1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 d5 4.Bg2 dxc4 5.Qa.strategy: Takes b5 away from the queen and prepares to gain space and time with ...b5. The advance has to wait until Black has dealt with the long diagonal, because the b-pawn leaving b7 uncovers the rook on a8 to the bishop on g2.
